name: cereal_fungicide

source.ed50_factor: [AS] resistance of fungi is not modelled; the factor must be >= 1.

source.half_life_days: [AS] no soil residual; the protection decays with the fungicide block.
source.germ_kill: [AS] a fungicide does not act on weed seedlings.

source.damage_in: [AS] no crop damage at the label rate.
source.damage_out: [AS] no crop damage at the label rate.

source.dose_exponent: [AS] unused: the product does no crop damage.

source.efficacy_max: [AS] largest share of the take-all loss a seed treatment or foliar programme buys back; AHDB advises a seed treatment for third wheat and calls take-all control by chemistry partial; no numeric efficacy was found. Always below 1: a fungicide never buys back the whole loss.
source.dose_half: [AS] dose relative to the label rate that gives half of efficacy_max (saturation dose/(dose + dose_half)); at the label rate 0.77 of efficacy_max (0.46).
source.half_life_days: [AS] the protection of one application fades with this half-life, 200 d: a seed or early-autumn treatment protects through the root-infection period.

source: F1d part 4: a partial-protection fungicide for the pathogen model. The spray path is the herbicide one (operation "spray": {"product", "dose"}).
